welcome.title: PitchProof
welcome.subtitle: Match evidence you control.
welcome.cardSubtitle: Build an evidence-based football profile from your matches and videos, and decide who can see it.
welcome.heroDescription: Log matches, confirm it is you on camera, and get coaching only when the footage supports it. Share a Football Passport with scouts when you choose.
welcome.guestHint: Guests can explore. Create an account later to keep matches, videos and your Passport.
welcome.trustFootage: Coaching only from footage you confirm
welcome.trustShare: Share a Passport only when you opt in

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue
login.cardSubtitle: Use your PitchProof credentials to continue.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Join PitchProof as a player or scout
register.cardSubtitle: Start building your football identity today.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll send a reset link to your email
forgotPassword.cardSubtitle: Enter the email linked to your PitchProof account.
forgotPassword.success: If an account exists for this email, a password reset link has been sent.

roleSelection.title: Choose your role
roleSelection.subtitle: How will you use PitchProof?
roleSelection.cardSubtitle: You can change privacy later. Coaches endorse players through invite links — no separate coach app is required.
roleSelection.playerDescription: Log matches, review footage with clear confidence limits, and share a Football Passport when you are ready.
roleSelection.scoutDescription: Find players who opted in, weigh logged evidence and film, and keep a shortlist — not a rating of potential.
roleSelection.coachDescription: Roster notes and session observations only. Coaches do not invent match stats.

accountUpgrade.title: Save your progress
accountUpgrade.description: Create a free PitchProof account to keep your data, unlock your profile, and access scouting tools. Your current session will be upgraded — nothing is lost.

apple.unavailable: Sign in with Apple is available on supported iOS devices.
apple.alreadyLinked: Apple Sign In is linked to this account.
apple.linkDescription: Link Apple Sign In to sign in faster on iOS while keeping your existing PitchProof account.
apple.linkSuccess: Apple Sign In has been linked to your account.
apple.linkFailed: Unable to link Apple Sign In. Try again or contact support.

google.unavailable: Google Sign-In requires a development or production build with OAuth client IDs configured.
google.alreadyLinked: Google Sign-In is linked to this account.
google.linkDescription: Link Google Sign-In to use your Google account with PitchProof.
google.linkSuccess: Google Sign-In has been linked to your account.
google.linkFailed: Unable to link Google Sign-In. Try again or contact support.

authAction.title: Account action
authAction.subtitle: Processing your secure link
authAction.cardSubtitle: Please wait while we verify your request.
authAction.verifyEmailSuccess: Your email has been verified. You can continue in PitchProof.
authAction.recoverEmailSuccess: Your email address has been recovered.
authAction.unsupportedMode: This link type is not supported in the app.
authAction.failed: This link is invalid or has expired.

completePasswordReset.title: Set new password
completePasswordReset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
completePasswordReset.success: Your password has been updated. Sign in with your new password.
completePasswordReset.failed: Unable to reset password. The link may have expired.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.body: For your security, please sign in again before deleting your account.
reauth.noMethod: Sign out and sign in again, then delete your account.

errors.failed: We couldn't complete account deletion. Please try again.
errors.wrongPassword: That password isn't correct. Please try again.
errors.wrongAccount: That's a different account. Sign in with the account you want to delete.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
